summary: This is the combined report for all **115 discovered Bitnami charts**, with per-chart findings below.
**Results:** 93 baseline-only checks, 20 property-test time limits, one skipped library, and one rendered-YAML parsing error (Zipkin).
The scan took **256.66 seconds** and made **767 property-test attempts**. Every discovered chart was visited. No chart completed a successful property-test run.

This retained run used **five generated examples and a five-second property-test budget per chart**, with a 30-second timeout per Helm command. Baseline-only charts lack a values schema; their successful lint/render checks do not establish permutation coverage. The Zipkin parsing error has not been established as a chart defect.
